summary: Full backend + frontend testing of TRU SYDS LLC single-page app. Backend: 6/6 pytest passed (contact CRUD, newsletter idempotency, Stripe checkout for ticket_hotc & donate_50, payment status, invalid lookup 500). Frontend: home loads with 3D hero canvas, WhatWeDo tabs toggle, Adinkra selector switches, ticket qty +/- updates, buy-tickets-btn calls /api/payments/checkout (200) and redirects to checkout.stripe.com, donate-50 triggers checkout (200), newsletter subscribes (200), contact form submits (200) and shows the send-another-btn confirmation state.

issues: Three.js deprecation warnings in console (THREE.Clock, PCFSoftShadowMap) — non-blocking but noisy
Klarna/Link/Amazon Pay payment methods not activated in Stripe dashboard — test-mode warning only

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/payments/checkout raises HTTPException(500) for missing price — semantically should be 400/404, but review_request explicitly expects 500 so left as-is.
server.py contains stripe + payments + newsletter + contact + webhook in one 178-line file; still manageable but consider splitting when adding more resources.
Contact confirmation state has no dedicated data-testid for the thank-you container (only send-another-btn); adding data-testid="contact-thankyou" would improve testability.
test_credentials: None required. Stripe test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 (not exercised — verified redirect to Stripe hosted checkout only, per request).
seed_data_creation: Stripe catalog assumed pre-seeded via setup_stripe.py (lookup_keys ticket_hotc, donate_25/50/100/250 all resolvable — verified indirectly by successful checkout responses).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL derived from /app/frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. All primary flows PASS. No blocking issues.
